FINAL SQL:
SELECT AirportCode
FROM airports
WHERE AirportCode IN (
    SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
)
GROUP BY AirportCode
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY SourceAirport
        UNION ALL
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM flights
        GROUP BY DestAirport
    )
);
